segments.text: The teacher of Aoko's class at school.
An old man who owns an antique shop.

Her family owns the mansion which she and Aoko reside in. She acts as Aoko's mentor in the ways of magic but commutes to a different high-school (has special dispensation since it's supposed to be a boarding school).

Initially tried to kill Aoko and Soujuurou when the latter witnessed their magical activities but was later convinced to let Soujuurou board at her mansion to keep an eye on him and find a way to remove his memories.

A young man from a rural location. In a way it's as if he's in a time slip state. Impressed by the city, but slowly adjusting into ordinary high school life. A person of few words, but possessing a warm personality. A person that most people can grow accustomed to. A stable person who tends to keep quiet, even if he really believes in something. Not a special person but not a normal person either.
from Type-Moon Wiki

Aoko is a member of the Aozaki family. When she was young, Aoko's grandfather, the third generation head chose to raise her older sister Touko as his successor while Aoko lived with her parents. When she was sixteen years old, Aoko was suddenly named the successor to the Fifth Magic by her grandfather, and Touko, who was being trained as the successor until that point, was abandoned. Therefore, she originally had a very bad relationship with her sister.

Alice's familiar, also served Alice's mother as a familiar. Capable of speech and frequently winds up Alice. Because Robin is effectively immortal, he is capable of surviving the spells of Touko and Alice when they try to silence him.
Aozaki Touko appeared as the sister of Aozaki Aoko in the novel Mahoutsukai no Yoru and made a later appearance in Kara no Kyoukai.

In Kara no Kyoukai, she is shown as a puppet maker and an occasional buildings designer. Together with Kokutou Mikiya, she runs a kind of detective agency (Garan no Dou (伽藍の洞)) that only engages in cases with supernatural or abnormal elements. Touko does not share a particularly good relationship with her sister, yet this break's causes are unknown.

She's a powerful magus, and she can reproduce parts of a body that can be used instead of the lost part. While this would be nothing special, she can copy the piece in such a perfect way that it comes close to the real one. The glasses Toono Shiki wears were initially made by Touko. Her sister Aoko stole them from Touko and made them indestructible.
As a doll-maker, she received a Sealing Designation for creating a doll (body) that was a replica of her own body.

Touko has 20 Magic Circuits, which surprised the Aozaki clan as the number of Magic Circuits in their line had been dwindling. Due to her formidable power, Mage's Association dubbed her with the color Tou (橙, Orange), close to the three primary colors. She wished to get the color Blue, but that title was taken by her sister Aoko.

The popular vice-president of the Student Council, a classmate of Aoko who becomes Soujuurou's best friend. He and Aoko were close friends as children, though they both deny having any feelings for one another. His family life is apparently complicated and he is known to casually smoke and spend nights out. Kojika Kumari has a crush on him which he is oblivious of.

The treasurer of the Student Council, a friend and classmate of Aoko who possesses a cool-mannered and realistic personality. She is very responsible as a result of being in charge of a household of brothers, but she dislikes how the men in her life look down on her. Though her father disapproves of her desire to attend college, Kojika still works hard to save money to attend anyways.

A classmate of Soujuurou, Hosuke is a cheerful young man whose primary interests are the attractive girls in class and becoming rich someday. He often tries to organize the male students in class, though his cunning often fails and the girls wind up pitying him instead. He is also Soujuurou's co-worker at their part-time job.

One of the antagonists of the story, an ageless nature spirit whose true form is a golden werewolf-like creature, though he appears as a fair-haired young boy. His existence is similar to the True Ancestors that appeared in Tsukihime. Other werewolves once revered him as the werewolf who would revive their race, but was ostracized and later sold to Touko Aozaki when it became apparent he was not a true werewolf.

segments.text: An idol singer who has travelled around the world, May is also a mage with an eccentric personality. She is acquainted with Soujuurou by unknown means and is known by the church. As a mage, her ability is considerable enough to cause trouble for Lugh (who wasn't taking her on seriously when they fought).

A member of the Mage's Association, though she has only been part of the organization for a year after leaving the Church. It is believed that Ritsuka is apprenticed to the Aozaki family to act as a watchdog, which is why Aoko is suspicious of Ritsuka's intentions.

Ritsuka's sister, a member of the church well-known in town as a pious nun. Virtually blind because of a genetic condition but her other senses compensate for her disability to the point she is hardly inconvenienced by her poor sight. Capable of acts of violence when angered.

A member of the Church. Despite his gentle personality, his advice is often critical and harsh. He was once apprenticed to the Aozaki family and happens to be Touko's old lover. Because he was strong enough to kill a witch, Touko remains vigilant around him.
